column7: description
column8: resolution

column7: Students see a blank page when they open the fee payment portal; nobody can pay semester fees.
column8: Restarted the payment app pods after a failed deployment and rolled back to the previous release.
column9: Bad release left the app containers in a crash loop

column6: Payment gateway timeout after TLS certificate expiry
column7: Fee payments fail with a gateway timeout; the app log shows SSL handshake errors to the payment provider.
column8: Renewed the expired TLS certificate on the payment connector and restarted the service. Added an expiry alert 30 days ahead.
column9: Expired TLS certificate on the outbound payment connector

column7: Transactions made by UPI show as pending for hours and the fee receipt is not generated.
column8: Reprocessed the stuck callbacks from the payment provider and fixed the webhook URL that changed after the server move.
column9: Payment provider callbacks pointed at the old server address

column7: After paying, students get an internal server error when downloading the fee receipt PDF.
column8: Fixed the receipt template that referenced a removed field and cleared the PDF cache.
column9: Receipt template referenced a field removed in the last release

column7: ERP and LMS report frequent timeouts while exam results are being published; the database shows deadlocks.
column8: Added the missing index on the marks table and split the bulk update into batches.
column9: Missing index caused lock escalation during the bulk update

column6: Replication lag on the database cluster
column7: Reports show stale data; the read replica is more than 20 minutes behind the primary.
column8: Increased replication workers and moved the nightly backup off the replica.
column9: Nightly backup saturated replica I/O

column7: Several portals throw 'too many connections' errors in the afternoon peak.
column8: Raised the pool limit and fixed a connection leak in the LMS grade-sync job.
column9: Connection leak in a scheduled sync job

column6: Unable to log in to campus SSO
column7: Students and staff get 'invalid credentials' on the SSO page even with the correct password.
column8: Restarted the SSO identity service and resynchronised it with LDAP after a stuck sync job.
column9: SSO lost its connection to the LDAP directory

column6: SSO login loop after certificate rotation
column7: After entering the password the browser keeps redirecting back to the login page for LMS and ERP.
column8: Re-imported the new SSO signing certificate into LMS and ERP and cleared their metadata cache.
column9: Applications still trusted the old SSO signing certificate

column6: OTP not received for two-factor login
column7: Users do not receive the one-time password SMS when signing in to the SSO portal.
column8: Switched the SMS gateway to the backup provider and raised the issue with the primary vendor.
column9: Primary SMS gateway outage

column6: Accounts locked out after password change
column7: Many faculty accounts are locked a few minutes after changing their password.
column8: Cleared stale credentials cached on the Wi-Fi controller that kept retrying old passwords and unlocked accounts.
column9: Wi-Fi controller retried cached old passwords

column7: Freshers created this week cannot log in anywhere; their accounts are missing from the directory.
column8: Re-ran the account provisioning job after fixing the CSV import that skipped rows with Hindi names.
column9: Provisioning import rejected names with non-ASCII characters

column7: No Wi-Fi in Hostel Block 5 since last night; phones see the network but cannot get an IP address.
column8: Replaced the failed PoE switch on the third floor and restored the access points.
column9: Failed PoE switch powering the floor access points

column6: Very slow Wi-Fi in hostels at night
column7: Internet in all hostels becomes extremely slow after 10 pm; video calls drop.
column8: Applied per-user bandwidth limits and fixed the QoS policy that was missing after the controller upgrade.
column9: QoS policy lost during the controller upgrade

column7: Students in Block 2 get 'authentication failed' when joining the hostel Wi-Fi.
column8: Restarted the RADIUS service that the Wi-Fi uses to check SSO credentials.
column9: RADIUS service hung after a memory leak

column6: No Wi-Fi in lecture hall complex
column7: Wi-Fi is unavailable in all lecture halls of the F block during classes.
column8: Rebooted the wireless controller and replaced a faulty uplink cable.
column9: Faulty uplink cable to the F-block distribution switch

column7: No internet anywhere on campus; internal sites work but external sites time out.
column8: Failed over to the backup ISP link and escalated the fibre cut to the primary ISP.
column9: Fibre cut on the primary ISP link

column7: Video lectures stutter and file transfers between the A and C blocks keep failing.
column8: Replaced a flapping optical transceiver on the core switch.
column9: Faulty optical transceiver on the core switch

column7: Users get 'server not found' for most websites although the network is connected.
column8: Restarted the DNS resolver and increased its cache memory; added a second resolver.
column9: DNS resolver ran out of memory

column6: Devices not getting IP addresses in labs
column7: Lab computers show 'limited connectivity' and a self-assigned IP address.
column8: Expanded the exhausted DHCP scope for the lab VLAN.
column9: DHCP address pool exhausted

column7: Course pages on the LMS take more than a minute to load during assignment deadlines.
column8: Enabled caching for course pages and added an application server for peak hours.
column9: Single app server overloaded at deadline peaks

column7: Students get an error when uploading assignment PDFs larger than 10 MB.
column8: Raised the upload size limit on the LMS and the reverse proxy.
column9: Reverse proxy upload limit lower than the LMS limit

column7: Some students' quiz answers disappear when they press submit.
column8: Fixed session timeout shorter than the quiz duration and restored answers from the autosave table.
column9: Session timeout shorter than the quiz time limit

column7: Faculty cannot mark attendance; the ERP attendance page shows an internal server error.
column8: Patched the null-pointer bug in the attendance module for courses without a section.
column9: Bug in attendance module for courses without a section

column7: Exporting the semester grade report to Excel spins forever for large departments.
column8: Moved the export to a background job and emailed the file when ready.
column9: Synchronous export timed out for large reports

column7: The ERP timetable shows last semester's slots for several courses.
column8: Re-ran the timetable import for the new semester and cleared the ERP cache.
column9: Timetable import job skipped the new semester

column7: Staff phones stopped syncing campus email; webmail still works.
column8: Re-enabled the mobile sync protocol that was disabled by a policy update.
column9: Policy update disabled mobile sync

column7: Emails to external addresses bounce with 'message rejected'.
column8: Fixed the SPF record after the mail relay IP changed.
column9: SPF record missing the new relay IP

column7: Faculty get 'mailbox full' warnings although their quota should be 50 GB.
column8: Applied the correct quota policy to faculty mailboxes.
column9: Faculty assigned the student quota policy

column7: Off-campus access to e-journals asks students to pay instead of logging them in.
column8: Updated the library proxy configuration for the publisher's new domain.
column9: Publisher changed domain; proxy rule missing

column7: Searching the library catalogue returns zero results for every query.
column8: Rebuilt the catalogue search index.
column9: Search index corrupted after a disk-full event

column7: Departments cannot save files to the shared drive; it reports no space left.
column8: Expanded the storage volume and archived old project folders.
column9: Storage volume reached capacity

column7: The desktop sync client shows 'authentication required' every few minutes.
column8: Updated the sync client and refreshed its token settings after the SSO change.
column9: Old sync client incompatible with new token lifetime

column6: File share very slow to open
column7: Opening files on the departmental file share takes minutes.
column8: Replaced a degraded disk in the storage array and rebalanced the volume.
column9: Degraded disk in the storage array

column7: A research group's virtual machine on the campus cloud fails to start.
column8: Freed up hypervisor capacity and restarted the VM on another host.
column9: Hypervisor host out of memory

column7: Ten computers in the CS lab show a black screen and do not boot.
column8: Replaced failed power supplies after a power surge.
column9: Power surge damaged the power supplies

column7: MATLAB in the labs says no licence is available.
column8: Restarted the licence server and renewed the expired network licence file.
column9: Network licence file expired

column6: Lab computers stuck on Windows update
column7: Lab machines are stuck at 'working on updates' at the start of the practical.
column8: Paused updates during lab hours and rolled back the failed update.
column9: Update schedule clashed with lab hours

column7: The projector in lab 3 shows 'no signal' with every laptop.
column8: Replaced the faulty HDMI cable and the projector input board.
column9: Faulty projector input board

column6: Printer jam in library print room
column7: The library print room printer jams on every job.
column8: Cleared the jam, replaced worn rollers and reloaded paper.
column9: Worn feed rollers

column7: Print jobs from the campus print portal stay queued and never print.
column8: Restarted the print spooler and removed the corrupt job blocking the queue.
column9: Corrupt print job blocked the spooler

column6: Phishing email asking for SSO password
column7: Many students received an email asking them to verify their SSO password on a fake page.
column8: Blocked the sender and the fake domain, removed the email from all mailboxes and reset passwords of users who clicked.
column9: Phishing campaign targeting campus accounts

column7: Antivirus reports malware on several lab machines after USB use.
column8: Isolated and re-imaged the infected machines and disabled USB autorun.
column9: Infected USB drives with autorun enabled

column7: Security alerts show many SSO logins to faculty accounts from foreign IP addresses.
column8: Forced password resets for affected accounts and enabled two-factor authentication for faculty.
column9: Credential stuffing with leaked passwords

column6: Student able to see others' grades
column7: A student reported that changing the URL in ERP shows other students' grades.
column8: Added an ownership check on the grade endpoint and audited access logs.
column9: Missing authorisation check on the grade endpoint

column6: Access point lights off in Block 7
column7: Two access points in Block 7 have no lights and the corridor has no signal.
column8: Replaced the burnt-out access points.
column9: Access points damaged by water leak

column6: Python packages missing in lab image
column7: The new lab image is missing NumPy and Jupyter needed for the data science course.
column8: Added the missing packages to the lab image and redeployed.
column9: Packages omitted from the new image

column7: Several lab desktops do not respond to keyboard or mouse input.
column8: Replaced the faulty USB hub and re-seated the peripherals.
column9: Faulty USB hub

column7: The payment gateway API returns 'merchant not authorised' for all transactions.
column8: Updated the rotated merchant API key in the gateway configuration.
column9: Merchant API key rotated by the provider

column7: Some students were charged twice for the same fee payment.
column8: Fixed the retry logic that resent payments on timeout and refunded duplicate charges.
column9: Non-idempotent retry on gateway timeout

column7: Faculty cannot connect to the campus VPN from home; the client times out.
column8: Renewed the VPN server certificate and restarted the VPN gateway.
column9: Expired VPN server certificate

column6: Payment API slow after cloud migration
column7: Fee payments take 30 seconds after the payment API moved to the cloud.
column8: Moved the payment API to the same region as the database and enabled connection reuse.
column9: Cross-region database calls

column7: The fee payment app shows last year's fee amount for second-year students.
column8: Corrected the fee schedule table and cleared the app cache.
column9: Fee schedule not updated for the new year

column6: Hostel Wi-Fi disconnects every few minutes
column7: Laptops in Block 4 keep disconnecting from Wi-Fi every few minutes.
column8: Changed overlapping channels on neighbouring access points and updated controller firmware.
column9: Channel interference between access points

column7: Monitoring shows the database cluster disk at 95 percent.
column8: Purged old audit partitions and added storage.
column9: Audit logs never archived

column7: Recorded lectures on the LMS show a spinning wheel and never play.
column8: Restarted the video transcoding service and reprocessed the stuck videos.
column9: Transcoding service crashed

column7: The 'forgot password' link on SSO says the link has expired immediately.
column8: Fixed the clock drift on the SSO server that made reset tokens expire instantly.
column9: Clock drift on the SSO server

column7: Meeting invites sent from the campus calendar do not appear in recipients' calendars.
column8: Repaired the calendar connector and re-sent pending invites.
column9: Calendar connector stopped after an update

column6: Wi-Fi drops in the library reading hall
column7: Wi-Fi in the library reading hall keeps dropping during exams week.
column8: Added two access points to handle the extra users.
column9: Too few access points for exam-week occupancy

column6: UPS alarm in the data centre
column7: The data centre UPS is beeping and shows battery fault.
column8: Replaced the failed UPS battery string during a maintenance window.
column9: UPS batteries past end of life
